description: After fz-kdt.177.13 supplies the runtime-owned predicate-program artifact and exact evaluator, project each canonical regular Ty into its finite component-local program graph. Builder memoization is keyed only by canonical Ty and reserves a node before descending; repeated Ty means a back-edge. The program is not a second global type interner or equivalence authority. Migrate list heads, tuple positions and callable captures to program-node references; relations use explicitly founded ordered node-pair calculations. Preserve acyclic predicate behavior, schema discovery and dispatch planning. Prove self/mutual tuple/list/capture components project finitely and agree with finite unrollings; hand the program to the shared primitive/receive lowering established by .177.13. Transport re-entry cuts remain .177.7.
title: Project canonical recursive types into runtime predicate programs
